en.headline: Mainland hotpot-ingredient chain Guoquan opens first Hong Kong store in Wan Chai
en.dek: The company, listed in Hong Kong, has opened its debut local outlet on Hennessy Road, describing the city as a testing ground for overseas expansion.
body: Mainland hotpot and barbecue ingredient retailer Guoquan Shihui has opened its first store in Hong Kong on Hennessy Road in Wan Chai.

The company, which operates more than 12,000 outlets across the mainland and is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange, said the new shop is intended as a testing ground for product development, supply-chain arrangements and local service standards as it explores further international expansion.

The store stocks a range of hotpot and barbecue ingredients adjusted for the Hong Kong market, including local-style sauces, and is positioned to serve nearby residents looking for convenient home-cooking options.

zh.headline: 內地火鍋食材連鎖鍋圈食匯灣仔開香港首店
zh.dek: 已於港上市的鍋圈食匯於軒尼詩道開設首間本地門店，形容香港是集團海外布局的試驗田。
body: 內地火鍋燒烤食材連鎖企業鍋圈食匯已在灣仔軒尼詩道開設香港首間門店。
該公司在內地擁有逾12,000間門店，並於港交所上市。管理層表示，香港是集團國際化探索的重要起點，期望藉此鍛鍊跨區域產品研發、供應鏈組織及本地服務能力，將香港視為拓展海外布局的試驗田。
新店貨品因應本地需求作出調整，包括加入港式沙嗲等醬料，定位為服務附近居民的社區食材點。
